original_two_findings_preserved.problem: A start dropped by the object/row bound returns before retiring an unresolved reused frame id. Its PY_RETURN can consume the old same-code span and falsely complete the earlier failed proof.

original_two_findings_preserved.fixed_control: 20/20 trials retain completed=0 and unresolved_spans=1. An analogous row-bound drop also keeps the failed span unresolved.
